'''Jesús María Tarriba Unger''' (born 1 September 1962) is a Mexican [[physicist]] and [[financial risk]] [[management]] expert who is the [[First ladies and gentlemen of Mexico|First Gentleman of Mexico]]. He is married to the President of Mexico, [[Claudia Sheinbaum]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com.mx/jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-especialista-en-riesgos-financiero-de-banxico-se-casa-con-sheinbaum/|title=Jesús María Tarriba Unger, especialista en Riesgos Financieros de Banxico, se casa con Sheinbaum|access-date=July 12, 2024|date=November 17, 2023|website=forbes.com.mx}}</ref> As the first husband of a president, Tarriba is the first First Gentleman in Mexican federal history.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://politica.expansion.mx/mexico/2024/06/03/quien-es-el-esposo-de-claudia-sheinbaum-jesus-maria-tarriba|title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba Unger, esposo de Claudia Sheinbaum?|access-date=July 12, 2024|date=June 3, 2024|website=politica.expansion.mx}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2024/06/03/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-pareja-claudia-sheinbaum-primer-caballero-mexico-orix/|title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba, esposo de Claudia Sheinbaum y futuro primer caballero de México?|access-date=July 6, 2024|date=June 3, 2024|website=cnnespañol.cnn.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/2022/11/23/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-futuro-esposo-de-claudia-sheinbaum-297474.html|title=Quién es Jesús María Tarriba Unger, futuro esposo de Claudia Sheinbaum|access-date=July 11, 2024|date=November 23, 2022|last=Pantoja|first=Sara|newspaper=roceso.com.mx}}</ref>

Tarriba worked as a quantitative analyst for [[Grupo Financiero Banamex|Banamex]] from 1994 to 1997.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2024/06/03/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-esposo-de-claudia-sheinbaum-y-el-primer-caballero/|title=Quién es Jesús María Tarriba, esposo de Claudia Sheinbaum y el primer caballero|access-date=July 11, 2024|date=June 13, 2024|last=Flores|first=Miguel|newspaper=infobae.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://mexico.as.com/tikitakas/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-esposo-de-claudia-sheinbaum-y-futuro-primer-caballero-de-mexico-n/|title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba, esposo de Claudia Sheinbaum y futuro primer caballero de México?|access-date=July 12, 2024|date=June 3, 2024|last=Méndez|first=Dora|newspaper=mexico.as.com}}</ref> He later moved to [[Spain]] to work with [[Banco Santander]] where he took up different positions, the most relevant being Director of [[Risk management|Risk Management]], a position he held from 2008 to 2016.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://elpais.com/mexico/elecciones-mexicanas/2024-06-05/jesus-maria-tarriba-el-esposo-discreto.html|title=Jesús María Tarriba, el esposo discreto|access-date=July 12, 2024|date=June 3, 2024|last1=Cota|first1=Isabella|last2=Raziel|first2=Zedryk|newspaper=elpais.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.foxsports.com.mx/2024/06/03/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-primer-caballero-en-la-historia-de-mexico/|title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba, primer caballero en la historia de México?|access-date=July 10, 2024|date=June 3, 2024|website=foxsports.com.mx}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Born on September 1, 1962, in the Mexican city of [[Mazatlán]], Sinaloa. Born to Jaime Tarriba Rodil, and Beatriz Unger Ferreia, his father was originally from [[Culiacán]] and his mother from Mazatlán.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Noroeste/Redacción {{!}} |title=Claudia Sheinbaum contrae matrimonio con el mazatleco Jesús María Tarriba |url=https://www.noroeste.com.mx/nacional/claudia-sheinbaum-contrae-matrimonio-con-el-mazatleco-jesus-maria-tarriba-EG5329372 |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=www.noroeste.com.mx |language=es-MX}}</ref>

He studied at the Instituto Cultural de Occidente in his hometown. In 1977, at the age of 15, he moved to [[Mexico City]] to study at a private high school.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Noroeste/Redacción {{!}} |title=Claudia Sheinbaum contrae matrimonio con el mazatleco Jesús María Tarriba |url=https://www.noroeste.com.mx/nacional/claudia-sheinbaum-contrae-matrimonio-con-el-mazatleco-jesus-maria-tarriba-EG5329372 |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=www.noroeste.com.mx |language=es-MX}}</ref>

He completed his studies at the [[School of Sciences, UNAM|Faculty of Sciences]] of the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM),<ref>{{Cite web |last=Baena |first=Por Mayte |date=2024-06-03 |title=Éste es el grado de estudios de Jesús María Tarriba, nuevo primer caballero de México |url=https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2024/06/03/este-es-el-grado-de-estudios-de-jesus-maria-tarriba-proximo-primer-caballero-de-mexico/ |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=infobae |language=es-ES}}</ref> where he obtained a bachelor's degree in [[physics]] in 1988, a master's degree in 1989  and a doctorate in Physical Sciences in 1994, with the thesis: " ''Optical and magnetic response of systems with interfaces'' ". During his training, he also completed a doctoral stay at the [[University of California, Irvine|University of California at Irvine]], which earned him the Weizmann Prize for Exact Sciences, awarded by the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]], for the best [[Thesis|doctoral thesis]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=García |first=Miriam |date=2024-10-01 |title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba Unger, el primer caballero de México? |url=https://www.quien.com/espectaculos/2024/10/01/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-esposo-claudia-sheinbaum |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=Quién |language=es}}</ref>

=== Career ===
In 1993 he was technical director at the United Advisors Group (GAUSSC).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Español |first=Por CNN |date=2024-06-03 |title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba, esposo de Claudia Sheinbaum y futuro primer caballero de México? |url=https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2024/06/03/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-pareja-claudia-sheinbaum-primer-caballero-mexico-orix |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=CNN |language=es}}</ref>

Since 2017, he has been a financial risk specialist at the [[Bank of Mexico]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Noroeste/Redacción {{!}} |title=Claudia Sheinbaum contrae matrimonio con el mazatleco Jesús María Tarriba |url=https://www.noroeste.com.mx/nacional/claudia-sheinbaum-contrae-matrimonio-con-el-mazatleco-jesus-maria-tarriba-EG5329372 |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=www.noroeste.com.mx |language=es-MX}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He married anthropologist Martha Tello Díaz, with whom he had a daughter. The couple later separated.<ref>{{Cite web |last=García |first=Miriam |date=2024-10-01 |title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba Unger, el primer caballero de México? |url=https://www.quien.com/espectaculos/2024/10/01/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-esposo-claudia-sheinbaum |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=Quién |language=es}}</ref>

During his college years, he met [[Claudia Sheinbaum]], whom he dated for a year.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-07 |title=Claudia Sheinbaum y Jesús María Tarriba, la pareja que se reencontró después de 30 años y se casó poco antes de que ella ganara la presidencia de México |url=https://www.bbc.com/mundo/articles/ceklpp4ed3ko |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=BBC News Mundo |language=es}}</ref> In December 2016, after returning from Spain, he met Sheinbaum again, and they began a relationship.<ref>{{Cite web |last=García |first=Miriam |date=2024-10-01 |title=¿Quién es Jesús María Tarriba Unger, el primer caballero de México? |url=https://www.quien.com/espectaculos/2024/10/01/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-esposo-claudia-sheinbaum |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=Quién |language=es}}</ref> On November 17, 2023, after a seven-year relationship, they married in a private ceremony.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Staff |first=Forbes |date=2023-11-17 |title=Jesús María Tarriba Unger, especialista en Riesgos Financieros de Banxico, se casa con Sheinbaum |url=https://forbes.com.mx/jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-especialista-en-riesgos-financiero-de-banxico-se-casa-con-sheinbaum/ |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=Forbes México |language=es}}</ref>
